The series has a high trend and strong seasonality but unstable ranking; a robust weighted combination over the full pool using inverse_error may capture complementary strengths.
Test a simple mean over the smaller, more correlated pool1 to see if restricting to the strongest models improves SMAPE, leveraging the strong trend and seasonality.
The leader used a simple mean on pool1; try a more robust DBA on the same pool to see if iterative weighting improves performance.
Test a robust weighted combination using softmax of negative error on the full pool to see if it captures complementary models better than inverse_error.
Test a weighted combination on the smaller, more diverse pool1 using inverse_error weights to see if focusing on the best performers in that subset improves over mean pool1.

The series has strong trend/seasonality and unstable ranking; a larger pool may capture more diversity. I will test a weighted combination on pool2 using inverse_error to see if adding CWT_catboost improves performance.
Test a weighted combination over the strong pool1 using softmax_neg_error to see if a probabilistic weighting improves over inverse_error which already leads.
The series has high trend and seasonality but unstable ranking; a robust central tendency like median over the full pool may mitigate outlier models.

The series has a very strong trend and seasonality but unstable rankings, so a robust weighted combination over a diverse pool may help. I will test a weighted combo on pool1 using the pre‑computed handle w1, which likely captures a different weighting scheme than the inverse or softmax methods already tried.
The series has a very strong trend and seasonality, but ranking instability suggests trimming outlier forecasts could help.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool1 weighted by w4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9593. Series context: trend strength 0.9863 and seasonal strength 0.7128; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.064); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.641.
